blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Thousands of birds have found a feeding and resting ground at Canarem Lake Bird Sanctuary in Victoria, Tarlac, where a recent bird-watching activity recorded 3,907 birds, highlighting the wetland’s importance as a refuge for migratory and resident species. Among the birds observed was the vulnerable Philippine duck (Anas luzonica), with 269 individuals counted. The Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR), in partnership with the provincial government of Tarlac and the local government of Victoria, conducted the activity in celebration of World Migratory Bird Day.
